lead_raw_text:
The structure of NdGa2Se3 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms—Nd4Ga8Se12—distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga centers with 11 geometric neighbors (4 Ga, 7 Se) and 9 neighbors (6 Ga, 3 Se), while Nd centers have 20 neighbors (4 Ga, 16 Se). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Ga and Nd coordination polyhedra, and among Se polyhedra.
